'''Commerce Master Commissioner''' was the civilian position in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for the individual who had oversight of the [[Velcar Free Commerce Zone]]. During the latter days of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the title was held by [[Gregor Raquoran]].
